description: This file contains the `Smarty_Internal_Runtime_UpdateCache` class, which implements runtime methods related to cache management in the Smarty templating engine. It includes methods to check for cache modification, update cache content, sanitize and remove no-cache parts from templates, and handle writing cache data to storage.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Runtime_UpdateCache
classes.description: A class providing internal runtime methods for cache management in the Smarty templating engine, including cache validation, updating, sanitization, and storage operations.

methods.name: cacheModifiedCheck
methods.description: Checks whether the client-side cache has been modified, given cached data, a template, and content.

methods.name: updateCache
methods.description: Checks if the cache is invalid and renders from the compiled template, then writes updates to the cache, including debugging hooks.

methods.name: removeNoCacheHash
methods.description: Sanitizes the template content by removing no-cache sections and escaping PHP tags, preparing content for caching.

methods.name: writeCachedContent
methods.description: Writes given content to the cache resource if caching is enabled and appropriate conditions are met.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Performs the actual writing of cached content to the cache handler; updates cache metadata and manages lock releasing.
